files.purpose: Pure decision: which scene follows the Start screen.
Thin MonoBehaviour: blinks the prompt and loads the next scene on any button.
Start screen layout: backdrop, title, prompt.
Start screen styles using the style guide palette.

integration_notes: Create Assets/Scenes/Start.unity (build index 0) with a GameObject 'StartScreen' holding UIDocument (Source Asset = Assets/UI/StartScreen.uxml, PanelSettings with Scale With Screen Size, reference 1920x1080) and StartScreenController.
Add Start (0), CharacterSelect (1), Match (2), Victory (3) to Build Settings; the flow falls back to Match when CharacterSelect is absent.
RuralRumble.UI asmdef must reference RuralRumble.Core, Unity.InputSystem; the EditMode test asmdef must reference RuralRumble.UI and RuralRumble.Core.
Ensure Assets/Art/Arena/arena_backdrop.png exists (referenced by the USS); UI Toolkit needs a default/runtime theme on the PanelSettings.
Optional: assign an arcade font via PanelSettings theme or USS -unity-font-definition.
assumptions: The arena backdrop (1600x900) serves as the trailer-park background, scaled and cropped to fill.
No dedicated title logo art exists, so the title is styled text in palette colors.
A 0.2 s input delay after scene load prevents carry-over presses; adjustable in the inspector.
